description: This source file defines the code-behind logic for the 'EditTheory' web page in an online examination system. It handles page load events, navigation button clicks, and dynamic population of course selection dropdowns based on selected semester and year.

classes.name: EditTheory
classes.description: Partial class for the EditTheory page, inheriting from System.Web.UI.Page, handling various UI events and dynamic dropdown population.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently empty.

methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click

methods.description: Stores selected course in session variable '_CRS'.

methods.name: logoutB_Click

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester, sorting courses alphabetically.
